description: List your Besidka projects, most recent activity first unless sorted by name, with id, name and pinned state. Use get_project to read instructions and the knowledge item list. Requires signing in (projects:read).

archived.description: List archived projects instead. Defaults to false

limit.description: Projects per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20

pinnedOnly.description: List only pinned projects. Defaults to false

sortBy.description: activity (most recent first, default) or name (A to Z)

name: list_projects
title: List my projects
